# Support Policy for Soroban Guard

Thank you for using Soroban Guard! We want to make sure your questions, feedback, and reports get to the right place quickly.

## Documentation and Resources

Before opening an issue or asking a question, please check our documentation:
- [Implemented Checks & Rules](../docs/checks.md)
- [Configuration Reference (`soroban-guard.toml`)](../docs/configuration.md)
- [False Positives & Suppressions](../docs/false-positives.md)
- [CI and Editor Integrations](../docs/integrations.md)
- [JSON & SARIF Output Schemas](../docs/json-schema.md)
- [Architecture Overview](../docs/architecture.md)

## Asking Questions and Getting Help

For general usage questions, how-tos, integration questions, or discussions:
- **GitHub Discussions**: Visit [SorobanGuard/Guard-CLI Discussions](https://github.com/SorobanGuard/Guard-CLI/discussions) to ask questions, share how you use Soroban Guard, or propose new ideas.
- **Stellar Developer Community**: Connect with developers building on Soroban on the [Stellar Developer Discord](https://discord.gg/stellardev) in the Soroban channels.

Please avoid using the GitHub issue tracker for general questions or usage support. Keeping issues focused on verified bugs and concrete feature proposals helps maintainers respond faster.

## Reporting Bugs

If you found a bug or unexpected behavior:
1. Search [existing open and closed issues](https://github.com/SorobanGuard/Guard-CLI/issues) to verify it has not already been reported.
2. If not, open a bug report using our [Bug Report Template](https://github.com/SorobanGuard/Guard-CLI/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
3. Include your `soroban-guard --version`, sample contract code, and the exact command executed.

## Proposing Features and Checks

- Check proposals: See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to suggest or implement a new detector check.
- Feature requests: Use the [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/SorobanGuard/Guard-CLI/issues/new?template=feature_request.md).

## Security Vulnerabilities

If you believe you have discovered a security vulnerability in Soroban Guard itself:
- **Do not** report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues.
- Please review our [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md) and submit a private report via [GitHub Private Security Advisory](https://github.com/SorobanGuard/Guard-CLI/security/advisories/new) or email `security@soroban-guard.dev`.
